{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Otheruses|wolf}}
A '''wolf''' was a hunter<ref name="Creatures of Endor">{{SWArchive|url=kids/explore/eu/f20041123|text="Creatures of Endor"}}</ref> canid creature that was difficult to domesticate, unlike the more docile [[Dog/Legends|dog]].

The [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]],<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] squad led by [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Rising Malevolence">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> had stylized wolf muzzles painted on their helmets.<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

"Wolf" was a common animal species used in the names of independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] operating throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>

==Breeds of wolf==
[[File:Borra.jpg|thumb|right|225px|A boar-wolf of Endor]]

*[[Korrina/Legends|Korrina]] of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]<ref name="DB-Asha">{{DB|character|asha|Asha}}</ref>

*[[Snow-wolf]] of [[Kabaira]]<ref name="Passages">{{JournalCite|7|Passages}}</ref>
*[[Vask-wolf|Vask-wolves]] of [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]<ref name="Nexus of Power">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

[[File:Wolf_of_Endor.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Wilk (wolf)|Wilk]], the sentient Wolf of Endor.]]

*A similarly named individual was [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]<ref name="Card-CCG-Colonel Wullf Yularen">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Colonel Wullf Yularen}}</ref>
